title: Phase944 Integrated Mechanism Trace
prompt: A red cube is placed on the table. The color of the cube is

pipeline.name: context state
pipeline.meaning: token embedding and residual stream contain object, relation, attribute and answer-format cues.

pipeline.name: conditioned routing
pipeline.meaning: attention and MLP update the residual stream differently under this context.

pipeline.name: candidate-space opening
pipeline.meaning: the color vocabulary becomes a measurable local candidate field.

pipeline.name: knowledge-path activation
pipeline.meaning: the target color gains margin against the strongest color competitor.

pipeline.name: output-boundary competition
pipeline.meaning: readout competition decides whether the next token enters the intended answer protocol.

pipeline.name: next token
pipeline.meaning: the final hidden state is projected through W_U to produce the next-token distribution.

O.中文: 对象因子：当前隐状态对对象词的输出读出强度。

R.中文: 关系因子：当前隐状态对关系词的输出读出强度。

A.中文: 属性因子：目标颜色相对其它颜色的方向投影。

C.中文: 类别因子：颜色类别整体是否被打开。

F.中文: 功能因子：回答格式、word/color/answer 等协议词的平均读出。

M.中文: 候选门控：颜色候选分布越尖锐，门控越打开。

K.中文: 知识路径：目标颜色相对最强竞争颜色的边际。

S_answer.中文: 语义答案场：目标答案 token 的直接输出读出强度。

B.中文: blocker field：最强错误候选颜色的读出强度。

G.中文: 边界齿轮：本层把目标边际推高还是压低。

N.中文: 自然 gate：attention/MLP 对当前 residual 的相对更新幅度。

P.中文: 输出协议：格式协议相对颜色候选场的读出偏置。

T.中文: 终止动作：句号、换行、EOS 等终止 token 的读出强度。

notes: Layer readouts before the final model norm are logit-lens style approximations; the final hidden state and final logits are exact for this forward pass.
The trace records the full layer-by-layer computational path and candidate readout over the selected color vocabulary, not only the largest neurons.
Raw vectors are omitted unless --save-vectors is set because frontend JSON would otherwise be very large.
